title: Creating an RPG to become a millionaire because I hate the call center
author: Weekly_Positive_2688
selftext: Currently putting it together with Claude, alot of meshy, an assortment of cc0 assets, and stable audio. This is one week into development (i've spent every waking moment on this), started out as a borderlands-like shooter but i decided to scrap that so a threw away a ton of UI features I need to recreate. Still learning the ins and outs of blender to get some more refined unique animations. If anyone out there wants to help vibe our way to the next World of Warcraft im open to building a team. This is just one zone out of several ive got cooking

comments.author: itstoyz
comments.body:
Pro tip, if you’re doing an MMORPG (which is kind of sounds like you’re getting at), start the project with multiplayer in everything you do, it’s extremely difficult / impossible to put it in afterwards. 

Also, from someone who has tried to do this many times and got extremely far… I’m sorry but Unity is not the way to go here. Unity is NOT good for this type of game - you will get to a certain point and the engine simply can’t handle it.

replies.author: Weekly_Positive_2688
replies.body: Im focusing primarily on single player, the idea is the game will respect the players time, but feel like an mmo. as for unity being bad for it, can you explain where exactly the issues begin to crop up?

replies.author: itstoyz
replies.body: You may be fine if it’s single player. It’s when it’s multiplayer that it starts to go terribly wrong.

replies.author: Weekly_Positive_2688
replies.body: ahh, if multiplayer was to be added I was thinking it would be more like Genshin's way of doing multiplayer by inviting a friend for co-op, but im not sure if that would even be worth it, ive always tended to play mmos on my own. Although a game chat would be cool too

replies.author: itstoyz
replies.body: Even if you do the co-op you’ll have to rebuild the whole game. Synchronising positions, animations, equipped gear, spell visuals, stats, damage numbers, aggro - everything has to be re-written to be client to client or client server infrastructure.
